title: Automatic Differentiation for Inference on Partially Observed Markov Process Models
abstract: arXiv:2407.03085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) has driven recent advances in machine learning, including deep neural networks and Hamiltonian Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods. Partially observed nonlinear stochastic dynamical systems have proved resistant to AD techniques because widely used particle filter algorithms yield an estimated likelihood function that is discontinuous as a function of the model parameters. To resolve this, we create a theoretical framework that embeds two existing AD particle filter methods within a new class of algorithms. This new class permits a bias-variance tradeoff and hence a mean squared error substantially lower than the existing algorithms. This allows us to develop likelihood maximization algorithms suited to the Monte Carlo properties of the AD gradient estimate. Our algorithms require only a differentiable simulator for the latent dynamic system; by contrast, most previous approaches to AD likelihood max

translated_title: 用于部分可观测马尔可夫过程模型推断的自动微分方法
translated_abstract: 自动微分（AD）推动了机器学习领域的最新进展，包括深度神经网络和哈密顿马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗方法。然而，部分可观测的非线性随机动态系统一直难以应用AD技术，原因在于广泛使用的粒子滤波算法所得到的似然函数估计值作为模型参数的函数是不连续的。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个理论框架，将两种现有的AD粒子滤波方法嵌入到一个新的算法类别之中。这一新算法类别允许进行偏差-方差权衡，从而使均方误差显著低于现有算法。这使我们能够开发出与AD梯度估计的蒙特卡罗特性相适应的似然最大化算法。我们的算法只需要潜动态系统具备可微分模拟器即可；相比之下，以往大多数针对AD似然最大化的方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的理论框架，将两种现有的自动微分粒子滤波方法纳入一类新算法，通过偏差-方差权衡显著降低均方误差，并据此开发了仅需可微分模拟器即可对部分可观测马尔可夫过程模型进行似然最大化的新算法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a theoretical framework that unifies two existing automatic differentiation particle filter methods into a new class of algorithms with a bias-variance tradeoff, substantially reducing mean squared error and enabling likelihood maximization for partially observed Markov process models that requires only a differentiable simulator.
